title: Evals: package P1 of 0.10.0, live (pass^3)
notes: Live, both models, 3 runs of each of P1's 28 cases, at 64a4ec8 (concurrency 2, a cap of
14,000,000 input tokens; the run used 12,160,431). Before it, `npm run eval:replay` without a key:
85 of 96 pass, and the 11 that fail are T's Flash recordings (the declaration of
`analyze_whole_document`).
Every gate holds on both models but one: Flash-Lite's inline-table questions with no count, in
one request (54%, 21 of 39). The integrator accepted that as a Flash-Lite deviation: each row or
cell lookup in a CSV or workbook takes a search or a read first (2 requests), which makes it exact
(0.9.0, by eye, got invoices-lookup wrong in 3 of 3 runs).
- **budget-count, read by eye** (its fact "number 23" passes any answer that holds a list of 23):
every answer begins with 23, on both models. Flash-Lite: 3 requests, aggregate_table twice,
about 12,100 tokens. Flash: 1 request, a list of 23 by eye, about 34 s.
- **orders-row on Flash-Lite, 2 of 3.** Run 3 answered "pending, 41.30 (orders.csv L1876)"; the
amount is 93.70, at L1880. Runs 1 and 3 searched in keywords mode (a result of about 1,000
tokens; replayed locally, "41877" in keywords mode gives one passage, L1841-L1880, with the order
on its last line), and run 3 took the amount from L1876 of that passage. Run 2 and the recording
searched in exact mode and got the one line. 0.9.0 missed this case in 1 of 3 runs the same way
(`failsOn090`), so no fact is lost, and no gate counts an English lookup.
- **"Unknown document_id": none seen.** The results keep each question's tool names and request
sizes, not the tool results, so the check is on the recordings at this head: 27 tool calls over
files sent whole, every one with the right document_id. In the live runs, the only first results
small enough to be an error are Flash-Lite's first aggregate_table calls on the budget (120-160
tokens), the size of the recorded first calls of budget-count and budget-sum-en. Those named
budget-1 and were refused for a column name: an ambiguous one ("ביצוע"), and one written without
its "/" ("רבעון 2 תקציב").
